description: What happened since a date (up to 92 days back) for your filters: counts and the newest notices of each kind, new calls for tenders, amendments and corrigenda with their change reasons, award results and prior information notices. Poll it to monitor a market, a buyer or a CPV code; each poll is one bounded paid call. Price: 0.01 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. How to call it: get_example {"tool":"tenders_get_changes"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/tenders/changes?country=RS&since=2026-10-01

country.description: buyer country, ISO code (DE, DEU, RS, SRB ...)

cpv.description: CPV code or prefix, 2-8 digits, e.g. 72 or 72000000

q.description: keywords in the notice text, e.g. cloud software

since.description: date YYYY-MM-DD (default 7 days ago, at most 92 days back)

name: tenders_get_changes
title: YRUZ TenderGraph Changes Since (0.01 USDC)
